title: Dysfunction of a SET3-like complex underlies a family of related neurological disorders
authors: Paton KM; Alexander-Howden B; Hare JI; Guy J; Chhatbar K; Yudina M; Walls R; Mathieson T; Spanos C; Bird AP; Lyst MJ
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SET3样复合物功能障碍与神经发育疾病，涉及转录调控但未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，无AI或物理模拟方法，仅间接相关。
abstract: TBLR1 is a subunit of the NCoR corepressor complex that is mutated in a range of neurodevelopmental disorders. Here, we report that TBLR1 functions as a molecular scaffold that physically connects ANKRD11 and SETD5 – two of the most frequently mutated proteins in neurodevelopmental disorders – and links them to the rest of the NCoR complex. The resulting assembly resembles the yeast SET3 complex (SET3C) – a transcriptional regulator. Pathogenic missense mutations in TBLR1, ANKRD11 and SETD5 disrupt this assembly, and an engineered mutation that specifically abolishes SETD5 incorporation into SET3C causes severe developmental impairments in mice. Disruptions of mammalian SET3C components cause highly correlated changes in gene expression – including upregulation of already highly transcribed genes. Together, our results reveal that failure of transcriptional regulation by SET3C is a convergent molecular basis for a family of neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstract_zh: TBLR1是NCoR辅阻遏物复合体的一个亚基，该复合体在一系列神经发育障碍中发生突变。在此，我们报告TBLR1作为分子支架，物理连接ANKRD11和SETD5——这两种蛋白是神经发育障碍中最常突变的蛋白之一——并将它们与NCoR复合体的其余部分连接起来。由此形成的组装体类似于酵母SET3复合体（SET3C）——一种转录调节因子。TBLR1、ANKRD11和SETD5中的致病性错义突变破坏此组装，而一种专门消除SETD5整合入SET3C的工程化突变在小鼠中导致严重的发育损伤。哺乳动物SET3C组分的破坏引起基因表达的高度相关变化——包括已高转录基因的上调。综合来看，我们的结果揭示SET3C转录调控的失败是家族性神经发育障碍的汇聚性分子基础。
